observations.body: A mystery gathers disobedience under mercy. For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in, For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

payload.tension: The passage states a mystery gathers disobedience under mercy. For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in, For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
